Short answer: Google needs to understand what the page is for and whether it helps a person. Clear text, accurate facts, original value, working pages, and honest structure beat a pile of repeated keywords.

What this means for your business

Technical SEO opens the door. Useful content earns the visit. A page should answer one real question, show why the answer is credible, and lead naturally to proof or action.

What to watch

  • Ten pages saying the same thing with a neighborhood swapped in.
  • A title that promises more than the page delivers.
  • Facts a crawler cannot see without an interaction.
  • Schema, headings, and visible copy telling different stories.

Do this next

  1. Give each page one question and one primary intent.
  2. Put the short answer near the top.
  3. Add first-hand detail, proof, or a useful method.
  4. Fix crawl, canonical, metadata, link, and mobile issues.
